four_questions.what: fly his rocket to a planet
four_questions.how: he spins to dodge a rock and lands

pages.text: I am Max. I have a big red rocket.
pages.illustration_prompt: Max beside a big red rocket, soft watercolor.

pages.text: I want to zip up to a planet.
pages.illustration_prompt: Max pointing up at a distant planet, soft watercolor.

pages.text: Blast off! The rocket is fast.
pages.illustration_prompt: Rocket launching with flames, soft watercolor.

pages.text: But a big rock is up top!
pages.illustration_prompt: A large space rock ahead of the rocket, soft watercolor.

pages.text: I spin. I miss the big rock!
pages.illustration_prompt: Rocket spinning around the rock, soft watercolor.

pages.text: I land on the planet. I win!
pages.illustration_prompt: Max landing the rocket on a colorful planet, soft watercolor.
